title: Character Traits
skills: identify character traits from actions, dialogue, thoughts, and relationships
distinguish character traits from emotions or temporary states
infer personality and values using textual evidence
analyze how character traits influence choices, conflicts, and outcomes
alignment_note: Introduces character traits and how readers infer them from a character's actions, dialogue, thoughts, and interactions. Supports characterization, inference, close reading, evidence-based analysis, and narrative understanding across high school English courses.
